title: Gado-gado with tofu, egg and peanut sauce
steps: Boil the diced potatoes for 12 minutes, adding the beans and cabbage for the last 4 minutes, and blanch the sprouts briefly; boil the eggs for 8 minutes.
Dice the tofu and fry it in the oil for 6–8 minutes until crisp.
Stir the peanut butter with soy sauce, lime juice, sambal, maple syrup and 4–5 tbsp hot water into a sauce.
Arrange the vegetables, cucumber, tofu and halved eggs and pour over the sauce.
